intent: Sum available-today units of the Bondex Garden Classic 106-TS1 deck-oil variant across every Graz PowerTool store (including zero-availability stores) and report as "qty %d".
success_criteria: Resolve the SKU(s) in the Bondex Garden Classic 106-TS1 Wood Stain and Deck Oil family whose variant product_type is 'deck oil'.
Enumerate ALL stores with city='Graz' via LEFT JOIN to store_inventory so branches with 0 availability are still counted.
Total = SUM(COALESCE(available_today_quantity,0)) over every Graz store for the matched SKU(s).
Final message is exactly 'qty %d' with the integer total.
refs cite every Graz store record_path plus the matched product record_path(s).

args.stdin: SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, pk.product_kind_name, pv.product_name, pvp.property_value_text AS product_type FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_kinds pk ON pk.product_kind_id = pv.product_kind_id JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pv.product_name LIKE '%' || :model || '%' AND pvp.property_key = 'product_type' AND lower(pvp.property_value_text) = lower(:product_type);
SELECT store_id, record_path, store_name FROM stores WHERE city = :city ORDER BY store_id;

WITH target AS (SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path AS product_record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pvp.product_sku = pv.product_sku WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pv.product_name LIKE '%' || :model || '%' AND pvp.property_key = 'product_type' AND lower(pvp.property_value_text) = lower(:product_type)) SELECT s.store_id, s.record_path AS store_record_path, t.product_sku, t.product_record_path, COALESCE(si.available_today_quantity, 0) AS available_today FROM stores s CROSS JOIN target t LEFT JOIN store_inventory si ON si.store_id = s.store_id AND si.product_sku = t.product_sku WHERE s.city = :city ORDER BY s.store_id;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
